provenance: synthetic teaching cases; no runtime observations

cases.task: Label all three synthetic address roles.
cases.expected: One node address, one Pod address and one virtual Service address.

cases.task: Predict what can change after Pod replacement.
cases.expected: Pod UID and IP can change while the Service remains stable.

cases.task: Draw the internal request path with both ports.
cases.expected: Service port 80 maps to Pod listener 8080.

cases.task: Diagnose a host browser trying a ClusterIP directly.
cases.expected: The host may have no route to that virtual cluster destination.

cases.task: Distinguish a node address from a public load-balancer address.
cases.expected: They may be different infrastructure endpoints with different policies.

cases.task: Explain a successful request with a changed backend UID.
cases.expected: Service continuity and backend identity are separate observations.
